Title: Friend lists show profile photos via a cacheable photo endpoint
Category: fullstack
Priority: P1

get-spec output:
Follow-up to the profile photo fix (dev commit dbc9a0f). Photos are now 256px JPEG bytes in CustomUser.profile_photo_data, served inline as a data URL only in the signed-in user's own payload. Friend search / friends overview rows (backend/users/friends.py _brief) return profile_photo null and the UI (FriendsModal) draws initials, because inlining ~30 KB per row would multiply across lists. Wanted: a cacheable way to show other players' photos in lists (e.g. GET api/users/<public_id>/photo/ returning the JPEG with a version/ETag so it caches, no per-row byte loads), then render it in FriendsModal rows with the initials Avatar as fallback. Keep the inline data URL for /me/. No paid storage.

I've classified this task as hard with high risk. Opus should build it after a Fable design round.

- **Why hard:** the change spans backend and frontend. It adds a new GET endpoint that returns JPEG bytes with a version or ETag so it can be cached. It changes the friends payload (`_brief` in `backend/users/friends.py`) and then renders the photos in `FriendsModal`. Any change that spans more than one area needs a design round.
- **Why high risk:** it changes production code for profile photos and friends. The design round also needs to decide who can fetch another player's photo, for example whether a blocked user can.
- **Why Opus:** the high risk sends it to Opus under the model rubric. It wasn't a close call, so I didn't add an entry to `DECISIONS.md`.
